disposition_mapping.rationale: Claim submission is preserved and combined with receipt capture/extraction into a single point-of-submission activity; the receipts-above-threshold input requirement (EXR-R-01) and step survival requirement (EXR-R-10) are both carried forward unchanged.
Receipt capture and extraction is unconstrained by design and is folded into the submission step via OCR technology operating at the point of entry, eliminating a separate manual handoff.

Policy compliance checking survives (EXR-R-07) but is restructured from a manual AP analyst review into a real-time rules engine with human exception handling, preserving its position before line manager approval (EXR-R-02).

Line manager approval survives in substantially unchanged form (EXR-R-08), remains ordered after the policy check (EXR-R-02) and before reimbursement (EXR-R-06), and retains actor separation from submission (EXR-R-03).

Finance review is unconstrained by design and is merged into the posting step as an exception-based control: straight-through postings proceed automatically while coding ambiguity, FX anomalies, or evidence gaps route to a finance reviewer, preserving the evidential-trail requirement (KB-02) and error-correction pathway (KB-05).

Posting is preserved and still consumes the expense transaction date (EXR-R-04) and transaction-date exchange rate (EXR-R-05), satisfying accrual timing (KB-01), FX translation at spot rate (KB-07), and exchange-difference tracking (KB-08); it now also absorbs finance review scope.

Reimbursement via the AP payment run survives (EXR-R-09), remains ordered after line manager approval (EXR-R-06), and is merged with notification since both are triggered by the same payment-confirmation event.
Employee notification is unconstrained by design and is merged into the reimbursement step as an automated confirmation triggered by payment completion, removing a separate manual handoff.

steps.description: The employee submits an out-of-pocket expense claim through a mobile/web capture tool that performs OCR extraction and structures the claim record at the point of submission, attaching receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold.
inputs: Receipts for claim lines above the receipt threshold
steps.name: Claim submission with automated receipt capture

steps.description: A rules engine checks claim lines against expense policy limits, categories and per diem rates in real time at submission; non-compliant or ambiguous lines are routed to an AP analyst exception queue for manual disposition before the claim proceeds to approval.
steps.name: Automated policy compliance check

steps.description: The claimant's line manager reviews and approves or rejects the policy-checked claim; the manager is organisationally distinct from the claimant to preserve segregation of duties.
steps.name: Line manager approval

steps.description: Approved claims are coded and posted straight-through to expense accounts and cost centres in the period the expense was incurred, translating foreign-currency lines at the transaction-date spot rate; claims with coding ambiguity, large exchange differences, or evidence gaps are routed to a finance reviewer for manual coding verification and evidentiary check before posting is finalised.
steps.name: Automated posting with finance exception review

steps.description: The approved, posted claim is paid to the employee through the AP payment run; the employee is automatically notified once reimbursement is confirmed.
steps.name: Reimbursement via AP payment run with automated notification
